<ComponentPreview name="column-demo" />

<PackageInfo>

## Features

- Add columns to your document.
- Choose from a variety of column layouts using `column-group-node` toolbar.
- With [Drag & Drop](/docs/plate/dnd), drop a block beside another block, on its inline-end edge or in the editor's side padding next to a top-level block, to place both in a new column group, or beside a block in a column to add a column, up to five.

</PackageInfo>

## Kit usage

<Steps>

### Installation

The fastest way to add column functionality is with the `ColumnKit`, which includes pre-configured `ColumnGroupPlugin` and `ColumnItemPlugin` with [Plate UI](/docs/plate/installation/plate-ui) components.

<ComponentSource name="column" />

- [`ColumnGroupElement`](/docs/plate/components/column): Renders column group containers.
- [`ColumnElement`](/docs/plate/components/column): Renders individual column items.

### Add kit

Add the kit to your plugins:

```tsx
import { createEditor } from 'platejs/react';
import { ColumnKit } from '@/components/editor/column';

const editor = createEditor({
  plugins: [
    // ...otherPlugins,
    ...ColumnKit,
  ],
});
```

</Steps>

## Manual usage

<Steps>

### Installation

```bash
npm install platejs
```

### Add plugins

Add `ColumnGroupPlugin` to the editor. It installs `ColumnItemPlugin` as the required structural dependency.

```tsx
import { ColumnGroupPlugin } from 'platejs/layout/react';
import { createEditor } from 'platejs/react';

const editor = createEditor({
  plugins: [
    // ...otherPlugins,
    ColumnGroupPlugin,
  ],
});
```

### Configure plugins

Configure the group and add a complete `ColumnItemPlugin` descriptor when you need to replace the dependency's render component.

```tsx
import { ColumnGroupPlugin, ColumnItemPlugin } from 'platejs/layout/react';
import { createEditor } from 'platejs/react';
import { ColumnGroupElement, ColumnElement } from '@/components/editor/column';

const editor = createEditor({
  plugins: [
    // ...otherPlugins,
    ColumnGroupPlugin.configure({ component: ColumnGroupElement }),
    ColumnItemPlugin.configure({ component: ColumnElement }),
  ],
});
```

- `component`: Assigns [`ColumnGroupElement`](/docs/plate/components/column) to render column group containers and [`ColumnElement`](/docs/plate/components/column) to render individual columns.

### Turn into toolbar button

Add a structural action that calls `BaseColumnGroupPlugin` directly. Enable it only when exactly one eligible block is selected.

```tsx
import { BaseColumnGroupPlugin } from 'platejs/layout';

const turnIntoItem = {
  icon: <Columns3Icon />,
  label: '3 columns',
  value: 'action_three_columns',
  onSelect: () => {
    const column = editor.plugin(BaseColumnGroupPlugin);

    if (!column.installed || editor.read.view.isReadOnly()) return;

    column.update.toggle({ columns: 3 });
  },
};
```

</Steps>

## Plugins

### `ColumnGroupPlugin`

Owns column groups and requires `ColumnItemPlugin`.

### `ColumnItemPlugin`

Owns the structural column item installed by `ColumnGroupPlugin`. Add it directly only to replace its default configuration or component.

## Types

### `ColumnGroupElement`

Extends `Element`.

### `ColumnElement`

Extends `Element`.

<API name="ColumnElement">
<APIAttributes>
  <APIItem name="width" type="string" optional>
    The column's width (must end with `%`)
  </APIItem>
</APIAttributes>
</API>

## Capabilities

The group plugin owns group operations. The item plugin owns item operations:

```tsx
const columnGroup = editor.plugin(ColumnGroupPlugin);
const column = editor.plugin(ColumnItemPlugin);

columnGroup.update.insert({ columns: 3 }, { select: true });
columnGroup.update.setColumns({ at: columnGroupPath, widths: ['33%', '67%'] });
columnGroup.update.toggle({ columns: 2 });
column.update.selectAll();
```

Group commands are also available through `editor.update.columnGroup`; item
commands are available through `editor.update.column`.

- `insert` inserts a group of equal-width column items after the current block.
  `select: true` selects its first paragraph; `replaceEmpty: true` replaces an
  empty source in the same history step. Use `after` to identify another source
  block or `at` for explicit node-insertion placement.
- `setColumns` changes the count and widths of an existing group.
- `toggle` converts the active block to a column group or updates its layout.
- `selectAll` expands a selection inside a column to the column group.

`ColumnGroupPlugin` also builds side drops through
`editorReads.transfer.side`, so
`editor.api.transfer.move({ nodes, to: { key, side: 'end' } })` places blocks
beside a top-level block in a new group, or beside a block in a column as a new
column of up to five. Adding a column gives it the group's mean width and scales
the group back to 100%. See [Build beside a block](/docs/plate/dnd#build-beside-a-block).
